name: core-vlm-ukcs-lithology-pilot
task: photo crop classification into five Russian lithology names

source.dataset: UKCS Q204/Q205 Subsurface Data products for Machine Learning Study
source.copyright: Figshare record MIT; source core photographs BGS/UKRI under Open Government Licence with attribution
source.attribution: Contains British Geological Survey materials © UKRI 2019 & 2020

posthoc_binary_grouping.interpretation: Exploratory grouping after inspecting the five-class result; external transfer is mixed.

evaluation.decision: Do not connect this adapter to the geologist-facing full-description workflow. Five-class accuracy is 45/118 and two classes have zero recall.

limitations: The original labels are expert work but photo crops and Russian translations were selected automatically and have not been approved by a geologist.
All training and holdout wells are from the related UKCS Q204/Q205 collection; external depositional and photographic domains require separate checking.
The model was asked for one lithology only. Texture, structure, contacts, sedimentary facies, depositional environment and a complete Russian core report were not evaluated.
Source-level BGS/UKRI attribution must accompany any material reuse; source-specific rights should be reviewed before shipping derived artifacts.
